purpose: Astronomical observation, measurement, models, mission constraints, and uncertainty from nearby worlds to cosmic scales.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Distinguish observed signal, model-based inference, and speculation. State time, scale, detection bias, uncertainty, and alternatives; do not present an unconfirmed signal as discovery.
